outcome: Diversity of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) in the infant gut microbiome
Relative abundance of ARGs in the infant gut microbiome
cohort: 210 infants (195 full-term and 15 late preterm) enrolled in the New Hampshire Birth Cohort Study
finding: Infants born via cesarean delivery had a trend towards a higher risk of harboring unique ARGs and an increased risk for overall ARG relative abundance at 1 year compared to infants born vaginally.
mod_finding: Infants born via cesarean delivery had a trend towards a higher risk of harboring unique ARGs and an increased risk for overall ARG relative abundance at 1 year compared to infants born vaginally.
gest_age: Full term (at least 37 weeks' gestation) and late preterm (33-36 weeks' gestation)
